function.name: impl_from_IOleObject
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IOleObject interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IOleObject interface from which the containing record is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: DefaultHandler * - Pointer to the containing record of type DefaultHandler.

function.name: impl_from_IUnknown
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface from which the containing record is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: DefaultHandler pointer, representing the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IDataObject
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IDataObject interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter represents the IDataObject interface for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: DefaultHandler* - Represents the containing record for the given IDataObject interface.

function.name: impl_from_IRunnableObject
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IRunnableObject interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to specify the IRunnableObject interface for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: DefaultHandler*; represents the containing record for the given IRunnableObject interface.

function.name: impl_from_IAdviseSink
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the DefaultHandler structure that contains the given IAdviseSink interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IAdviseSink interface

function.return_type: DefaultHandler pointer, representing the DefaultHandler structure that contains the IAdviseSink interface pointer

function.name: impl_from_IPersistStorage
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IPersistStorage interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPersistStorage interface

function.return_type: DefaultHandler pointer that represents the containing record for the given IPersistStorage interface pointer

function.name: object_is_running
function.description: This function checks if the object is running by calling the IRunnableObject_IsRunning method on the IRunnableObject interface of the object.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the object that we want to check if it is running.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the object is running or not.

function.name: start_object_call
function.description: This function increments the 'in_call' property of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DefaultHandler object whose 'in_call' property is to be incremented.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: end_object_call
function.description: This function decreases the in_call count of the DefaultHandler object. If the in_call count reaches 0 and the object_state is object_state_deferred_close, it stops the DefaultHandler.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the DefaultHandler object whose in_call count is to be decreased and possibly stopped.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: DefaultHandler_NDIUnknown_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface based on the provided interface identifier (riid). It checks if the requested interface is supported, and if so, it returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the object for which the new interface is being requested.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if ppvObject is NULL.

function.name: DefaultHandler_NDIUnknown_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the DefaultHandler object after increment.

function.name: DefaultHandler_NDIUnknown_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the DefaultHandler object. If the reference count becomes zero, the object is destroyed.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IUnknown interface of the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the DefaultHandler object after decrement.

function.name: DefaultHandler_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface from a DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. The value S_OK indicates success and any other value indicates failure

function.name: DefaultHandler_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count for an interface on an object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that needs its reference count incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the object after the increment.

function.name: DefaultHandler_Release
function.description: This function releases the DefaultHandler object by calling the IUnknown_Release method on its outerUnknown member.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface that is used to get the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count. This value is intended to be used for test purposes only.

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetClientSite
function.description: This function sets the client site for the default handler. It also manages the reference count for the client site.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface that represents the object for which the client site is being set.

parameters.name: pClientSite
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleClientSite interface that represents the client site to be set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, error code otherwise.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetClientSite
function.description: This function retrieves the client site for the default handler. If the client site is not null, it increments the reference count of the client site.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface.

parameters.name: ppClientSite
parameters.description: Address of IOleClientSite pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the client site.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetHostNames
function.description: This function sets the host names for a DefaultHandler object. It first checks if the object is running, and if so, it starts an object call and sets the host names. It then cleans up any existing host names before re-assigning the new ones.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the DefaultHandler object

parameters.name: szContainerApp
parameters.description: Name of the container application

parameters.name: szContainerObj
parameters.description: Name of the container object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: release_delegates
function.description: This function releases the delegates and sets them to NULL.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DefaultHandler object whose delegates are to be released

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: DefaultHandler_Stop
function.description: This function stops the default handler by releasing its delegates, disconnecting its data advise holder, and setting its object state to not running. It also unadvises the OleDelegate and releases the cache control if the query for the interface is successful.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the DefaultHandler instance that needs to be stopped.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: DefaultHandler_Close
function.description: This function closes the DefaultHandler object and stops its operation. It first checks if the object is running, if not it returns S_OK. If it is running, it starts an object call, attempts to close the IOleObject, ends the object call, and then stops the DefaultHandler.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the object that needs to be closed.

parameters.name: dwSaveOption
parameters.description: This parameter represents the options for saving the object before closing it.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the object is not running, otherwise it returns the result of the IOleObject_Close function.

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetMoniker
function.description: This function sets a moniker for a default handler object if the object is running.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface

parameters.name: dwWhichMoniker
parameters.description: Specifies the moniker

parameters.name: pmk
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetMoniker
function.description: This function is used to get a moniker that can be used to create a link to the object. If the object is running, it delegates the call to the object's IOleObject interface. If the object is not running but has a client site, it delegates the call to the object's IOleClientSite interface. If neither condition is met, it returns E_FAIL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleObject interface of the object.

parameters.name: dwAssign
parameters.description: Specifies the degree of moniker assignment.

parameters.name: dwWhichMoniker
parameters.description: Specifies which moniker to return.

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Address of IMoniker pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, and an error code on failure.

function.name: DefaultHandler_InitFromData
function.description: This function initializes a DefaultHandler object from data. It checks if the object is running, and if so, it starts an object call, initializes the object from data, and ends the object call.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an IOleObject

parameters.name: pDataObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object from which the DefaultHandler object is to be initialized

parameters.name: fCreation
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the object is being created

parameters.name: dwReserved
parameters.description: Reserved DWORD value

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the object is not running, it returns OLE_E_NOTRUNNING.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetClipboardData
function.description: This function checks if an object is running, if so, it starts the object call, gets the clipboard data, ends the object call and returns the HRESULT status.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the object

parameters.name: dwReserved
parameters.description: Reserved DWORD value

parameters.name: ppDataObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataObject interface pointer to receive the interface pointer to the data object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. OLE_E_NOTRUNNING if the object is not running, otherwise the status of IOleObject_GetClipboardData operation

function.name: DefaultHandler_DoVerb
function.description: This function runs an object and starts an object call, then performs a verb on the object and ends the object call.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to an OLE object

parameters.name: iVerb
parameters.description: Specifies the verb to be performed

parameters.name: lpmsg
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that specifies a message

parameters.name: pActiveSite
parameters.description: Pointer to the active client site

parameters.name: lindex
parameters.description: Specifies the index of the verb

parameters.name: hwndParent
parameters.description: Handle to the parent window

parameters.name: lprcPosRect
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that specifies the position rectangle

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. If the function call is successful, it returns S_OK. If the function call fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_EnumVerbs
function.description: This function is used to enumerate the OLE verbs for a given object. If the object is running, it calls the IOleObject_EnumVerbs function. If the HRESULT returned is OLE_S_USEREG, it calls the OleRegEnumVerbs function.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface pointer for the object.

parameters.name: ppEnumOleVerb
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IEnumOLEVERB interface, which will receive the enumerated OLE verbs.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If it failed, it returns an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_Update
function.description: This function updates the default handler. It checks if the object is running, if not, it returns an error. If the object is running, it starts the object call, updates the IOleObject and ends the object call.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the OleObject that needs to be updated.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns the updated IOleObject. If the object is not running, it returns an error.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IsUpToDate
function.description: This function checks if the default handler is up to date. If the object is running, it starts an object call, checks if the OleObject is up to date, ends the object call, and returns the result.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to interact with the OLE Object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It returns OLE_E_NOTRUNNING if the object is not running, otherwise it returns the result of the IOleObject_IsUpToDate function.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetUserClassID
function.description: This function retrieves the CLSID for an object and handles the object based on its running state. If the object is running, it delegates the call to the object's IOleObject interface. If the object is not running, it directly assigns the object's CLSID to the provided pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleObject interface of the object

parameters.name: pClsid
parameters.description: Pointer to a CLSID variable that receives the object's class identifier

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds. If the pClsid pointer is NULL, it returns E_POINTER. If the object is running, it returns the result of the delegated IOleObject_GetUserClassID call.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetUserType
function.description: This function retrieves the user type name of the object from the registry or the delegate, if the object is running.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface.

parameters.name: dwFormOfType
parameters.description: The form of the user type name to be retrieved.

parameters.name: pszUserType
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that receives the user type name.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetExtent
function.description: This function sets the extent of an object. It checks if the object is running, if so, it starts an object call, sets the extent, and ends the object call.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface

parameters.name: dwDrawAspect
parameters.description: The aspect of the object

parameters.name: psizel
parameters.description: Pointer to a SIZEL structure that specifies the intended size of the object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the object is not running, it returns OLE_E_NOTRUNNING.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetExtent
function.description: This function is used to get the extent of an object. If the object is running, it gets the extent from the IOleObject interface. If not, it queries the data cache for the IViewObject2 interface and gets the extent from there.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface.

parameters.name: dwDrawAspect
parameters.description: Specifies the aspect to be used for subsequent drawing operations.

parameters.name: psizel
parameters.description: Pointer to a SIZEL structure that should receive the object's extent.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_Advise
function.description: This function is used to create an advise holder if it doesn't exist and then advise the advise holder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer used to get the implementation from IOleObject

parameters.name: pAdvSink
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface

parameters.name: pdwConnection
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD to receive the advise connection

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise it returns an error code

function.name: DefaultHandler_Unadvise
function.description: This function unadvises a connection from an IOleObject interface. If the object does not have an advise holder, it means it does not have a connection and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface

parameters.name: dwConnection
parameters.description: A connection to be unadvised

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns OLE_E_NOCONNECTION if the object does not have a connection, otherwise returns the result of IOleAdviseHolder_Unadvise function

function.name: DefaultHandler_EnumAdvise
function.description: This function is used to enumerate through the advise holders of an OLE object. If the advise holder does not exist, the function returns S_OK. If the pointer to the enumeration interface is null, it returns E_POINTER.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the OLE object.

parameters.name: ppenumAdvise
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the enumeration interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT. This represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the pointer to the enumeration interface is null, or the result of the IOleAdviseHolder_EnumAdvise function.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetMiscStatus
function.description: This function retrieves the status of an object and checks if it is running. If the object is running, it starts an object call, gets the object's miscellaneous status, ends the object call, and returns the HRESULT. If the object is not running, it retrieves the object's miscellaneous status from the registry. If the retrieval fails, it sets the status to 0 and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleObject interface

parameters.name: dwAspect
parameters.description: Specifies the aspect of an object

parameters.name: pdwStatus
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the status of an object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status code of the function execution

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetColorScheme
function.description: This function sets the color scheme for a given IOleObject. It first checks if the object is running, then starts the object call, sets the color scheme, and ends the object call.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface for the object that the color scheme is being set for.

parameters.name: pLogpal
parameters.description: This is the new color scheme that is being set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the object is not running, it returns OLE_E_NOTRUNNING.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IDataObject_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a data object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the data object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It can indicate success or failure, and carries information about the result of the function.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IDataObject_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to the IDataObject interface of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataObject interface of the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the IDataObject interface of the DefaultHandler object.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IDataObject_Release
function.description: This function releases the IDataObject interface of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataObject interface of the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the outer unknown object after the release operation.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetData
function.description: This function retrieves data from a source data object. The function implements error handling and checks the running state of the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that allows a client to communicate with a data object

parameters.name: pformatetcIn
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device for notification

parameters.name: pmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to a STGMEDIUM structure that defines the storage medium in which the data is being transferred

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It can return various status codes, including S_OK if the function is successful, E_UNEXPECTED if an unexpected error occurs, or OLE_E_NOTRUNNING if the object is not running.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetDataHere
function.description: This function is a stub and not yet implemented. It is expected to handle data retrieval in the default handler.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the data object

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: pmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to a STGMEDIUM structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function call. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: DefaultHandler_QueryGetData
function.description: This function queries the data object to get the data. If the object is running, it starts the object call and queries the data again. If the object is not running, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function execution. It can be a success code, an error code or a warning code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetCanonicalFormatEtc
function.description: This function checks if the object is running, starts the object call, gets the canonical format, ends the object call, and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the data object

parameters.name: pformatetcIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device that the caller would like to use for a subsequent data transfer

parameters.name: pformatetcOut
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that receives the most general information possible for a subsequent data transfer

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It can return OLE_E_NOTRUNNING if the object is not running, or the result of IDataObject_GetCanonicalFormatEtc function call.

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetData
function.description: This function sets data to a default handler. It first retrieves the default handler from the IDataObject interface, then queries the data cache for an IDataObject interface. If successful, it sets the data using the IDataObject_SetData function.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataObject interface

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: pmedium
parameters.description: Pointer to a STGMEDIUM structure

parameters.name: fRelease
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether to release the data object after setting the data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_EnumFormatEtc
function.description: This function is used to enumerate the FORMATETC structures for a data object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataObject interface

parameters.name: dwDirection
parameters.description: Specifies the direction of the enumeration

parameters.name: ppenumFormatEtc
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumFORMATETC interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK.

function.name: DefaultHandler_DAdvise
function.description: This function is used to create a data advise holder if it doesn't exist and then advise the data advise holder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataObject interface

parameters.name: pformatetc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Advise flags

parameters.name: pAdvSink
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface

parameters.name: pdwConnection
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD to store the advise connection

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_DUnadvise
function.description: This function is used to remove a previously set up advisory connection.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataObject interface on the object that the client is managing.

parameters.name: dwConnection
parameters.description: The connection token previously returned from the IDataObject_DAdvise method.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the data advise holder does not exist, the function returns OLE_E_NOCONNECTION. If the function fails for other reasons, it returns an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_EnumDAdvise
function.description: This function delegates the enumeration of data advise if a data advise holder object exists. If the pointer to the enumeration advise is null, it returns an error. Otherwise, it sets the enumeration advise to null and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the data object from which the implementation is derived.

parameters.name: ppenumAdvise
parameters.description: Pointer to the enumeration advise. This function sets it to null if a data advise holder object doesn't exist.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if the pointer to the enumeration advise is null, S_OK if the operation is successful, or the result of IDataAdviseHolder_EnumAdvise if a data advise holder object exists.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IRunnableObject_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a runnable object and returns the interface if it is available.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunnableObject interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the interface is successfully obtained, otherwise it returns an error code

function.name: DefaultHandler_IRunnableObject_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to the IRunnableObject interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to represent the IRunnableObject interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IRunnableObject_Release
function.description: This function releases the IRunnableObject interface and returns the number of objects that still hold a reference to this object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IRunnableObject interface to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the number of objects still holding a reference to this object after the release operation.

function.name: DefaultHandler_GetRunningClass
function.description: This function is currently not implemented and always returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to a runnable object.

parameters.name: lpClsid
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLSID of the object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, in this case always S_OK indicating success.

function.name: DefaultHandler_Run
function.description: This function is responsible for running a default handler. It checks if the object is already running, if not, it releases delegates, creates an instance, sets client site, initializes or loads storage, sets host names, queries interface, and finally runs the cache control. If any of these steps fail, it stops the default handler and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the runnable object

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise it returns the error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IsRunning
function.description: This function checks if the DefaultHandler object is in a running state.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface to the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the DefaultHandler object is running or not.

function.name: DefaultHandler_LockRunning
function.description: This function is currently not implemented and always returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to a runnable object

parameters.name: fLock
parameters.description: Flag to lock or unlock the object

parameters.name: fLastUnlockCloses
parameters.description: Flag that determines if the last unlock operation closes the object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, always returns S_OK in the current implementation

function.name: DefaultHandler_SetContainedObject
function.description: This function is a placeholder for a function that is not yet implemented. It currently returns S_OK without performing any operations.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer to a runnable object.

parameters.name: fContained
parameters.description: This parameter is a boolean flag indicating whether the object is contained or not.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. Currently, it always returns S_OK indicating a successful operation.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IAdviseSink_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (riid) matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IAdviseSink. If it does, it assigns the interface pointer to the output parameter and increments the reference count of the interface. If it doesn't, it returns an error code indicating no such interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The interface identifier that is being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored if the requested interface is supported.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK indicates success and E_NOINTERFACE indicates that the requested interface is not supported.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IAdviseSink_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to the IAdviseSink interface of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface of the DefaultHandler object

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count to the IAdviseSink interface of the DefaultHandler object

function.name: DefaultHandler_IAdviseSink_Release
function.description: This function releases the IAdviseSink interface and returns the number of objects in use.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface that is to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the number of objects still in use after the release operation

function.name: DefaultHandler_IAdviseSink_OnRename
function.description: This function handles the renaming event in the IAdviseSink interface. If the oleAdviseHolder object exists, it sends a renaming notification.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface which is being used for the renaming operation.

parameters.name: pmk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface which represents the new name of the object.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IAdviseSink_OnSave
function.description: This function is used to handle the 'OnSave' event for the 'IAdviseSink' interface in the 'DefaultHandler'. If the 'oleAdviseHolder' is not null, it triggers the 'SendOnSave' event on the 'oleAdviseHolder'.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the 'IAdviseSink' interface that the 'OnSave' event is being handled for.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: DefaultHandler_IAdviseSink_OnClose
function.description: This function handles the closing of an IAdviseSink interface. If the oleAdviseHolder is not null, it sends a close notification. If not in a call, it stops the DefaultHandler. If in a call, it defers the shutdown and sets the object state to deferred close.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the IAdviseSink interface that is being closed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPersistStorage interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. The value S_OK indicates success and any other value indicates failure

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to the IPersistStorage interface of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPersistStorage interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the AddRef operation

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_Release
function.description: This function releases the IPersistStorage interface of the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPersistStorage interface of the DefaultHandler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the DefaultHandler object after the release.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_GetClassID
function.description: This function retrieves the class identifier (CLSID) of an object that can be stored persistently in the system. It checks if the object is running and based on that, it calls the appropriate function to get the CLSID.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the object whose CLSID is being requested

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Pointer to the location that receives the CLSID on return

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It could be a success or an error code

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if the storage object is dirty (modified). It first checks the data cache, and if it's not dirty, it checks if the object is running and then checks the delegate storage.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the storage object that needs to be checked.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the storage object is not dirty, it returns S_FALSE. It can also return other standard COM error codes.

function.name: load_ole_stream
function.description: This function opens an OLE stream from a given storage. If successful, it reads the stream header and checks its validity. If the header is valid and indicates a linked object, a warning is issued as this is not yet supported. If the header is not valid, a warning is issued and the function returns an error. If opening the stream fails, it attempts to create a new OLE stream.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DefaultHandler object

parameters.name: storage
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage object from which the OLE stream is to be opened

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or the error that occurred

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_InitNew
function.description: This function initializes a new storage object and sets up the necessary streams and states for the DefaultHandler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the IPersistStorage object

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage object to be initialized

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise an error code

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_Load
function.description: This function loads an OLE stream, checks if the object is running, and updates the storage state if the operations are successful.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the persistent storage object

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage object where the OLE stream is loaded from

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operations performed within the function. If the operations are successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise it returns an error code

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_Save
function.description: This function saves the persistable object. If the object is running, it also saves the delegated persistent storage.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the persistent storage object

parameters.name: pStgSave
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage where the object needs to be saved

parameters.name: fSameAsLoad
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the save operation is the same as the load operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or failure

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_SaveCompleted
function.description: This function completes the saving process of a storage object and manages the storage state accordingly.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the persist storage object.

parameters.name: pStgNew
parameters.description: Pointer to the new storage object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or failure.

function.name: DefaultHandler_IPersistStorage_HandsOffStorage
function.description: This function handles the storage handoff for the default handler of IPersistStorage interface. It releases the storage if it exists and sets the storage state to uninitialised.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IPersistStorage interface which is used for the storage handoff.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: DefaultHandler_Construct
function.description: This function constructs a DefaultHandler object. It initializes the object, sets the vtable pointers, creates a datacache object, and handles the object's lifetime and state.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Class identifier for the object

parameters.name: pUnkOuter
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to control the behavior of the object

parameters.name: pCF
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory that creates the object

function.return_type: Returns a pointer to the constructed DefaultHandler object

function.name: DefaultHandler_Destroy
function.description: This function destroys a DefaultHandler object by releasing its delegates, freeing its memory allocations, and setting its pointers to NULL.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the DefaultHandler object to be destroyed

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: OleCreateEmbeddingHelper
function.description: This function creates a default handler for an embedded object, which can be used to create an instance of the object.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: The CLSID of the object to be created.

parameters.name: pUnkOuter
parameters.description: If non-NULL, the outer unknown of the aggregate object.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags associated with the object creation.

parameters.name: pCF
parameters.description: A pointer to the class factory.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: The address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObj contains the requested interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if successful, or an error HRESULT if the function fails.

function.name: OleCreateDefaultHandler
function.description: This function creates a default handler for a specified object class. It is typically used when an in-process server cannot be found for a given object.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: The CLSID of the object that needs a handler.

parameters.name: pUnkOuter
parameters.description: If non-NULL, the handler being created is part of an aggregate, and pUnkOuter is the controlling IUnknown. If NULL, the handler is not part of an aggregate.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The identifier of the interface to the handler.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: The address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface specified in riid, the implementation must set *ppvObj to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the error values specific to this function, or a general error value.

function.name: impl_from_IClassFactory
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a HandlerCF structure that contains the given IClassFactory interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to get the containing HandlerCF record.

function.return_type: HandlerCF pointer, representing the containing record of the given IClassFactory interface pointer.

function.name: HandlerCF_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IClassFactory. If it does, it assigns the interface to the provided void pointer and increments the reference count of the interface. Otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that needs to be checked

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID that needs to be matched

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a void pointer where the interface will be assigned if the IDs match

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the IDs match, otherwise returns E_NOINTERFACE

function.name: HandlerCF_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the HandlerCF object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the HandlerCF object from its IClassFactory interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: HandlerCF_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the HandlerCF object. If the reference count becomes zero, it frees the memory allocated to the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the HandlerCF object whose reference count is to be decremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the HandlerCF object after decrementing.

function.name: HandlerCF_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a HandlerCF class.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the object that is to control the lifetime of the new object

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, success or error code

function.name: HandlerCF_LockServer

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is not used in the function.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns S_OK.

function.name: HandlerCF_Create
function.description: This function creates a HandlerCF object, initializes it and queries an interface based on the provided interface ID. If the function fails, it frees the allocated memory.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: A reference to the CLSID of the object

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: A reference to the IID of the interface to be queried

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: A pointer to the location of the requested interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.
